scope: Only 12 preregistered dev recordings x clean/noisy x base41k/control1000/fusion1000, DDIM seed0. No confirmation predictions, no final3000/all43 decision.
input_fingerprint_scope_note: Stored recursive input SHA is checked against artifact and exactly across models; fresh CPU input hashes can differ from GPU construction through floating reference math. Source sensor arrays are freshly exact; reference uses stated CPU/GPU tolerance.
denominator_notes: World/PA have 192*22 samples; acceleration has (192-2)*22 samples; no cross-window differences.
GT low-speed foot mask uses 3D GT joint speed<0.2m/s at30Hz; horizontal speed is predicted speed on that mask, not velocity error or measured stance.
Full-frame foot Y error uses 192*2 samples and compares GT joint height, not sole clearance or scene penetration.
Observed-head denominator uses input availability and positive confidence, recorded here separately because row.counts omits this metric.
Dataset reports are equal-recording window means; macro gives each dataset one third. Missing metric windows are skipped, never zero-imputed; all direct missingness/counts verified model-independent.

denominators.stride_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the two per-lag means; not pooled pair mean.
